Comment.value: Sowing Discord in Bree reagent (roadmap: sowing-discord-bree): one of the three forged letters Bill Ferny hands out in q_sow_start; consumed one per table by q_sow_plant (SetPlotFlag FALSE then DestroyObject). Plot + cursed so it cannot be dropped, sold or stashed -- carrying one IS the in-progress quest state (QSOW_InProgress). BaseItem 29 + ModelPart1 32 copied from the module's existing Sharkey's Orders letter.

value.0: A letter in a fine, respectable hand -- not the hand of whoever actually wrote it. This one accuses a Bree notable, by name, of informing for Angmar; the others in the bundle are no kinder. The paper is good, the seal is convincing, and every word is poison. Ferny wants each letter tucked under a different table in the Prancing Pony, quietly, where the right wrong person will find it.
